about_the_game:
A strange noise persists. One day it just started and would not go away... A whisper in the dark. An unfamiliar presence, just beyond your sight.

You are drawn into a world of spiraling darkness, where nothing is as it seems, and suffering is both a language and a landscape. Strange oddities surround you... Every object tells a story, not all of them want to be remembered

As you search for clues buried within the shadows, the world around you unfolds. The deeper you look, the more your mind begins to fracture. What seems like a simple task soon becomes an obsession — uncovering things best left hidden.

Find the items. Piece together the fragments. But beware — the darkness may already be inside you.

Prepare yourself for:

  • 4+ hours of tense, story-driven horror gameplay

  • First person immersive gameplay drenched in atmosphere

  • Collect cryptic items and uncover clues to push forward

  • Engaging environmental challenges that reward exploration and wit

  • Dynamic sound design — every creak, whisper, and distant footstep matters

  • A presence that watches... waits... and appears when you least expect it

content_descriptors.notes: Disclaimer: Contains references to drug usage, self-harm, violence, gore, suicide and mental illness,
